|---|---|---|

| Warranty | 10 years, if serviced yearly | 5 years |

- TermoCasa looks cheaper at 3,400 EUR, but that is ex VAT; all in it is 198 EUR more than Rossi.

One caveat: the current boiler is only from 2019 and Marta suspects the pressure drop is just the expansion vessel. Ask her to confirm full replacement is needed before accepting either quote.
